'''Senin Vant''' was an [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] who lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war, Vant served as an [[Air Commodore/Legends|Air Commodore]] in the [[Utapau Skyforce/Legends|Utapau Skyforce]] at the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

==Biography==
Senin Vant served as an [[Air Commodore/Legends|Air Commodore]] in the [[Utapau Skyforce/Legends|Utapau Skyforce]]<ref name="ICS" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Film III">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At some point before the Confederacy's [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]] occupied Utapau<ref name="ICS" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', which are concurrent with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems']] occupation of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> [[Senin Vant's Porax-38 starfighter|Vant's Porax-38 starfighter]] was taken on a joyride without its [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] enabled. During the joyride, the [[Porax-38 starfighter]] struck an [[Utapaun flying squid/Legends|Utapaun flying squid]] resulting in damage to the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] right [[Wing (technology)|wing]].<ref name="ICS" /> 

The damage was still visible on the [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] when Separatist forces under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] arrived on Utapau and [[Tion Medon/Legends|Tion Medon]]&mdash;the planet's [[Chairman of Utapau/Legends|Master of Port Administration]]&mdash;ordered his outmatched Porax-38 force into hiding.<ref name="ICS" /> Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date2">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] with the Republic, arrived on Utapau with a [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|contingent]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]<ref name="ICS" /> in search of Grevious.<ref name="Film III" /> During the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|ensuing battle]], Vant led the Utapau Skyforce from their Porax-38 starfighter [[Starfighter combat/Legends|against]] Separatist occupation force.<ref name="ICS" />

==Personality and traits==
Vant was an [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] with [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="ICS" />

==Equipment==
While [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] their Porax-38 starfighter, Vant wore a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] and a [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]].<ref name="ICS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vant was introduced in the [[2005]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', written by [[Curtis Saxton]]. A picture of Vant in the book was illustrated by [[Hans Jenssen]] and [[Richard Chasemore]].<ref name="ICS" />
